name: session-handoff
description: Writes a structured session handoff on demand to ~/.claude/handoffs/<project>/ (never into the project), resumes from the newest one, restarts into a fresh conversation with the handoff (pill or /handoff fresh) and hints once when the context fills up.

hintThreshold.title: Handoff hint threshold
hintThreshold.description: Context fill in percent (1-99) at which a one-time hint suggests /handoff. /handoff hint <n> overrides it.
